acceptanceCriteria: verifyAnchor derives the artifact class of the anchored path from project-owned authority (spec/decision status, test/source classification, execution receipts) and refuses or downgrades to UNKNOWN an anchor whose declared authority does not match.
A regression test anchors a PRESCRIPTIVE clause labelled ACCEPTED_INTENT to a pinned generated file and to a pinned source file and shows neither is admitted SUPPORTED.
The HDCV0-024 trace row names the test.
body: Filed 2026-10-04 from the V1-0712 output-class inventory (docs/build-log/2026-10-04-v1-0712-output-class-inventory.md), source origin/main a2615609. Confirmed from source, runtime NOT_RUN. HDCV0-024 says generated documentation, model output, history and learned traces are never an anchor authority and that a PRESCRIPTIVE clause qualifies only on ACCEPTED_INTENT. verifyAnchor (internal/doccompiler/admission.go:214) checks that the label is in anchorAuthorities, that the path is pinned in the index, and that blob and span digests match, but never checks that the anchored path belongs to the declared class. A proposed clause can therefore label any pinned file (a generated doc, a model-written note, a test) ACCEPTED_INTENT and be admitted SUPPORTED. Callers: AdmitClauses via admittedplan.go:129 and admission.go:304.

completion.reason: All three criteria met by beamfall/corvint#540, merged 2026-10-04T17:24:40Z as 9a721022 via auto-merge. Evidence digests = sha256 at main cd70ba0a of docs/specs/human-documentation-compiler-v0.md and internal/doccompiler/admission_test.go: (1) verifyAnchor derives the anchored path's artifact class from project-owned authority (built index spec status, generated/source/test classification, receipts) and disqualifies a declared authority naming another class; (2) TestAnchorAuthorityMustMatchTheArtifactClassHDCV0024 shows ACCEPTED_INTENT on a pinned generated file and on pinned source is not admitted SUPPORTED, and TestAnchorClassComesFromTheBuiltIndexHDCV0024 repeats it over a real contextindex.Build; (3) the HDCV0-023..026 trace row names both tests (amended 2026-10-04, V1-0741). make gate NOT_RUN (scoped work).

title: Doc compiler admits an ACCEPTED_INTENT anchor without checking that the anchored path is accepted intent (HDCV0-024)
